messages:
mina: Quick thread  updating the "rate limits & quotas" section. Need a short example for documenting quota-exhausted behavior and a snippet for the SDK header rename (X-Redwood-Org -> X-RW-Org). Also want a Grafana expression that shows remaining quota per tier.
evan: For remaining quota per tier you can do something like:
```
quota_limit_by_tier - increase(redwood_tokens_total[24h])
```
assuming quota_limit_by_tier is a gauge labeled by customer_tier. Wrap with max(...,0).
raul: For quota-exhausted example we should show curl errors and HTTP 429 body. Example: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "message": "Daily quota exceeded for your plan: upgrade or wait until reset (UTC).",
    "quota_window_reset": "2026-03-22T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```
mina: That's perfect. I'll add wording: "Quota windows reset at 00:00 UTC, per-day quotas are computed from 00:00-23:59 UTC". Also add migration stub:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-RW-Org: org_123" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate
```
docs-bot: PR opened by @mina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/954 reviewers: @evan @raul
mina: merging tomorrow unless r+ objections. :sparkles:
